description.value: Walk-in tent sites in old-growth cedar forest 3.5 km west of Revelstoke on the Trans-Canada, with resort flush showers, hot tub, and coin laundry a short walk from the pad; fees apply and no power or wifi at the tent.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible with multiple subpages providing strong amenity evidence. The /rv-sites/ and /glamping-camping/tent-sites/ subpages explicitly confirm potable water, complimentary hot showers, and coin-operated laundry; the site navigation confirms The Pantry & Café as an on-site food option. Contact details on the /contact/ page (phone, address) match OSM tags exactly, and a 2025 blog post confirms the business is actively operating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-established year-round resort directly adjacent to Revelstoke's world-class mountain biking trails, with showers, laundry, potable water, and on-site food — a strong fit for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: flush showers, hot tub, and coin laundry … adjacent to Revelstoke's world-class mountain biking trails
